scripts.check:manifest: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/manifest.json','utf8'));if(JSON.stringify(a)!==JSON.stringify(b))throw new Error('Root and public Chrome manifests differ');console.log('Both Chrome manifests are valid and identical')"
